summary: Net plugin over shm fabric: 2-rank real NCCL allreduce numerics pass (sum=3.0 both ranks) via NET/sim/0 with 4 channels. Mailbox relaxed from exact-size to recv_max (accepts mlen<=cap) to handle posted capacity vs actual bytes. Multi-channel (MIN/MAX_NCHANNELS=4) byte-correct. CPU-only (no GPU).
